existing_ON_detector_coverage.verification_strength: Restored current status independently confirms completed 1536 adjacent ON and 762 central ON maps and 766/768 combined domains. Exact source-map inventory, per-map metadata and payload provenance require the new phase preflight; this review has not enumerated or decoded those source maps.

observations.old_scope_novelty_limit: No restored current result examined here declares this three-native global ON DC-aware cached-winner selection. That absence alone is not an exhaustive history search; corroborate against restored original ON results and cross-ON reports before freeze.

recommended_new_scope.priority: DC-aware selection of already stored per-carrier winning drift/width tuples in all 766 ON reference domains, separately for the three HIP98505 ON scans, followed by unchanged fixed-path measurements in all six original scans.
recommended_new_scope.selection_units: TOP3 per original ON scan, not TOP3 for a pooled HIP98505 target. All three scans observe the same source in one visit; their labels are not three independent targets or observing epochs.
recommended_new_scope.distinct_geometry_counts: Determine after selection from exact paths; neither 9 distinct templates nor 54 distinct physical profiles is pre-established.
recommended_new_scope.why_higher_yield_than_more_OFF_TOP100_pr: It directly prioritizes the intended ON source, while the latest all-carrier pass selected only OFF controls. Expanding lower-ranked OFF winner profiles can diagnose receiver/interference or selection behavior but is a weaker next source-target question after unchanged nine OFF choices.
recommended_new_scope.do_not_repeat_adjacent_ON_detector_searc: Those 1536 ON map instances were already completed. Restoring raw arrays or archived maps does not create a new search or a new observation.

mandatory_time_provenance_preflight.warning: Do not copy the previous OFF own-first-midpoint dt=0 assumption into historical ON maps.
mandatory_time_provenance_preflight.observed_generic_detector: cadence_geometry uses one shared cadence midpoint tref=(first+last)/2 and saves per-map scan_first_time_from_tref_s. An original ON adapter may override this geometry. The actual pinned historical driver and per-map metadata govern.
required: Resolve each original ON frequency_hz_at_tref reference epoch and its exact 16-element times_from_tref_s from original pinned driver and metadata.

Use np.rint((stored_frequency-FCH1)/DF + stored_winning_drift*original_row_time_from_tref/DF) in complete absolute source coordinates, with the original arithmetic order, before subtracting crop origins.
Do not re-anchor cached reference frequency to an ON first midpoint or snap near-zero drift; algebraically similar expressions can change half-channel rounding.
Context times must retain the same original reference convention and original absolute rounding. Do not transport through a reconstructed own-epoch frequency if it changes original centers.
Verify selected own scores against original saved map scalars using their original full preprocessing and static normalization cores.

selection_invariants: Authenticate whole source NPZ bytes and original map metadata before any payload decoding; validate disjoint reference domains and unique reference carriers per ON scan.
Expected ON domain includes native171 q64/128/192; the preceding OFF 763-domain inventory must not be copied unchanged.

Reject a stored winner only if its width1/3 box touches a frozen DC center in any of the original 16 own rows, using that map's actual time reference. Keep original scalar score and winning drift/width.
Use exact frozen deterministic global order and an adequately proven prefix. The prior >3 reference-channel rule remains a descriptive spacing rule; it does not identify independent physical sources.

Full normalization support and score-cell median501 support must be available for every transported context. Freeze any unsupported-profile handling before outcomes and do not adapt the shortlist afterward.

grouping_and_inference.same_reference_frequency: Descriptive only. Even with one common tref, different drift/width can represent different physical paths; with different epochs even equal frequencies and equal drifts need not match.
grouping_and_inference.raw_profile_identity: Original source scan, width and all 16 absolute rounded score-cell centers. Template identity compares the complete six-scan family of these profiles.
grouping_and_inference.normalized_score_identity: Raw geometry plus the original fixed physical 4096-channel normalization core and identical full preprocessing terms. Separate this from raw-path alias grouping.
grouping_and_inference.source_identity: Distinct sampled paths can still be aliases of one physical receiver/RFI structure. Geometry groups are measurement templates, not astrophysical source counts.
grouping_and_inference.ON_repetition: Other ON scans are useful fixed-path context on the same target, but they are already exposed observations in one historical visit. Own-versus-context excess is conditioned on selecting frequency/drift/width from the own scan.
grouping_and_inference.OFF_controls: Retain the three actual OFF pointings and their original roles. No OFF veto qualification or star exclusivity follows from absence at one exact transported gridded path.
grouping_and_inference.DC_rule: Avoiding three exact DC centers removes their direct box contribution; it does not certify freedom from DC leakage, other receiver structure, RFI or chance maxima.

remaining_incompleteness: Each carrier stores only its maximum over the original drift/width hypotheses. A DC-contacting maximum can hide a clean nonwinning hypothesis at that carrier; this proposed pass does not recover it.
TOP3 per scan is a descriptive shortlist, not exhaustive fixed-context analysis of all eligible maxima. Failure to appear is not absence of a signal.
No new frequency coverage, observation, independent visit, nonlinear track family, calibrated false-alarm probability, sensitivity, flux or EIRP limit is established.
The two outer reference domains and all unrecorded source bands remain outside the declared inventory.
